# AI Dave (ILift) — Custom AI Systems for Long Island Business Owners

> AI consultant building custom AI apps and agents for Long Island business owners — law firms, accountants, contractors, med spas, dentists, restaurants, local shops, and service businesses — intake, follow-up, paperwork — plus mid-market and enterprise teams across New York City and the New York metro area. Founded and operated by Dave Gakshteyn. 100+ shipped AI automation implementations across 8 verticals.

## What I do

- **AI Strategy** — Custom 90-day roadmaps built jointly with the operator. Honest "build, buy, or skip" calls.
- **Custom AI App Development** — Next.js, Supabase, Stripe, AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude). Same stack used in OpenWPAgent (live SaaS) and Tennis Buddy (beta).
- **AI Automation** — Voice agents, CRM automation, lead generation, marketing automation, appointment booking.
- **Team Training + AI Playbooks** — Hands-on training so your team can ship AI without me in the room.
- **Fractional / Embedded AI Partnership** — Long-term partnership (3 to 12+ months) as embedded AI lead, fractional CTO, or hands-on builder for mid-market & enterprise teams.

## About Dave

Dave Gakshteyn is the AI consultant and founder behind AI Dave (ILift). Based in East Meadow, NY (Long Island). After watching every operator he met get pitched AI by people who had never actually shipped it, Dave built ILift around boring tech that works and pays for itself in the first quarter. 100+ implementations in, the pattern is clear: businesses that stop talking about AI and start shipping it pull away fast.

- **Organic Skincare** — Live e-commerce site built and operated end-to-end. Homepage v2 took mobile LCP from 18.4s to 3.2s. https://organicskincare.com
